latitude.tooltip: Your geographic latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 50.0875 for Prague

longitude.tooltip: Your geographic longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 14.4214 for Prague

accent-color.tooltip: Sun, time hand, equinox and LST stars, and the sunrise/sunset glow on the hour ring and sky band

foreground-color.tooltip: Hour numerals, LST readout, zodiac and planet glyphs, the moon, and the dial's rules and hairlines

day-color.tooltip: Color of the fully-lit sky on the hour ring and sky band

dial-size.tooltip: Diameter of the dial in the popup; larger values improve readability
